description.content: Lists contacts in a specified group

query.description:
Filters contacts by their phone `number`
  
The value _**must**_ be in the E.164 format and URI-encoded (eg. `+18004445555` would become `%2B18004445555`)
Filters contacts by their `name` (Will only return contacts whose name matches **exactly**)
Filters the contacts by their `screened` status (eg. if _**you**_ blocked them)
Filters the contacts by opt-out status (eg. if they texted `Stop`, `Cancel`, `Block`, `Quit` or `End` - [more info](https://sendhub.force.com/support/s/article/SendHub-Number-FAQ))

Sort contacts by a specified field (prepend a hyphen to reverse order)

**Must** be a built-in contact field, not a custom field
